h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Berhampur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Berhampur

c: Berhampur, also called Brahmapur, lies in Ganjam district near the Odisha coast, where cyclones from the Bay of Bengal are a real part of planning any outdoor structure. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Berhampur to schools, colleges, university campuses, municipal parks and residential colonies. We manufacture the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 1,250 km away, and deliver it by road.

Strong winds and heavy rain call for firm fixing. On most sites near the coast, we recommend grouted installation, where each post is set in a concrete footing. It keeps machines steady in storms and on soft, wet ground. The climate is hot and humid for much of the year, and salt reaches some distance inland, so galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic parts are the right choice over painted steel. After a cyclone or heavy storm, walk round the gym, check every footing and joint, and clear any debris before people use it again.

richText.heading: Firm fixing for a coastal Odisha site

items.q: Will outdoor gym machines survive a cyclone in Berhampur?
items.a: Grouted footings keep machines firmly fixed, and galvanised frames resist corrosion. After any storm, check footings and joints and clear debris before use. Report any damage to our after-sales team.

items.q: Is grouting or self-standing better near the coast?
items.a: Grouting is usually better on coastal sites because it holds the machine firmly in wind and on soft ground. We confirm the method for each machine after seeing your site.

items.q: Do you install in Ganjam district?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, dispatch by road and install through our team or a dealer covering eastern India.
